editorial.blurb: Arturo's Tacos delivers authentic, generously portioned Mexican street food that earns passionate devotion for standout tacos al pastor, carne asada, and crispy offal—though service and ambiance can be inconsistent.
editorial.insiderTip: Come with cash to tip and avoid card fees; order the tacos al pastor or carne asada, and ask about weekend menudo and soups—sit on the left side of the dining area for better comfort.
